name: Prisma Dual Decurions
tradeable: unranked only, no Forma or Catalyst

groups.activity: crack relics, sell Prime parts at a Relay Ducat Kiosk
conditions: Maroo's Bazaar has no Ducat Kiosk; use any other Relay.

alt.text: or 105 Aya at Varzia, 5 Ducats each

groups.activity: buy it on a visit that stocks it
groups.meta: every two weeks for 48 hours; stock rotates
conditions: Baro's stock changes each visit, so it may be missing on the next one.

disclosures.title: other routes
disclosures.body: During TennoCon, Baro's special Relay is open to anyone with a ticket, and his stock there covers almost everything he has sold.

disclosures.title: using it as a Heavy Weapon
disclosures.body: On the ground it needs the Archgun Deployer (inbox reward after Profit-Taker phase 3), and the gun needs an Orokin Catalyst and a Gravimag installed.

rows.note: arrives built, no blueprint or foundry step
